records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Wanted to check if timing was the issue -- if now's better than when you signed up, happy to do a quick setup call.

Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Chidi,

Thanks for the check-in. We like it so far, just need to get the rest of the team added.

Ana

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Good to see Clearwater Partners has a real project going. Let me know if you want a second pair of eyes on how it's structured.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Clearwater Partners
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Engaged, responsive admin: project created day 1 (facts), welcome call held [calendar:f1a973c6], and Ana stated intent to add the team [email:c1499e67]. But no invites 3 days later and key_milestone unreached with 8 days left; stated intent often slips. Pro plan and active status favor follow-through.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the update, and good to hear the first project is working for you. On getting the rest of the team added: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, which is usually easier for a whole team at once. Seats can be added any time from Account Settings too.

If it helps, I'm glad to walk through adding the team with you on a short call this week \u2014 happy to find a time that suits.

Best,
Chidi
